package auth

import "errors"

// ErrSessionExpired is returned by Check for a session past its expiry.
var ErrSessionExpired = errors.New("auth: session expired")

// Session is the server-side half of a signed-in user.
type Session struct {
	ID      string
	UserID  string
	Expires int64
	Rotated int64
}

// Check reports why s is unusable, or nil when it is usable at unix second now.
func (s Session) Check(now int64) error {
	if s.Expires <= now {
		return ErrSessionExpired
	}
	return nil
}

// NeedsRotation reports whether s is older than the rotation window.
func (s Session) NeedsRotation(now, window int64) bool {
	return now-s.Rotated >= window
}
